messages:
ops-june: T-minus 30m to the lights-out sterile window for release v2.7.1. Change window start 2026-03-21 20:00 UTC. Please ack and follow the checklist below.

sam-rl: Ack. I'll own canary watchers and metrics.

maya-p: Ack. I have the release notes/rollout doc: https://redwood.internal/releases/v2.7.1 — please don't edit after check-in.

ops-june: Key items: pin model-serving to v2.7.1, freeze infra changes, no config merges unless emergency, rollback owner assigned. Quick checklist in order: 1) Pin 2) Smoke 3) Canary 5% 4) Monitor 2m SLOs 5) Gradual ramp.

sre-robin: Rolling freeze enabled on infra side. No auto-scaling changes allowed during window.

maya-p: Quick patch note: changed embed cache eviction TTL from 2h -> 1h (safe) — included in release notes.

ryan-pd: Release notes approved. Product QA gave green on the sample prompts.

sam-rl: Deploy command I'll run at T-10: `/deploy release=v2.7.1 region=us-west canary=5% smoke=true`

deploy-bot: Received deploy request: `/deploy release=v2.7.1 region=us-west canary=5% smoke=true` queued by sam-rl.

deploy-bot: Step 1: pin route -> pinned service/model to v2.7.1 (pin-id: pin-6112).

deploy-bot: Step 2: smoke-run -> smoke status: PASS. Summary: health checks OK, median latency change +3ms, error-rate <0.1%.

sam-rl: Canary started at 20:03 UTC (5%). Watching request traces and p99 latency.

ops-june: Canary watchers: @sre-robin (metrics), @sam-rl (traces), @maya-p (user-facing tests). Rollback owner: @sre-robin. Rollforward owner: @ops-june. Emergency contact: #oncall-phone.

sre-robin: Noted. I see a tiny memory bump in one pod group; monitoring alert thresholds set to warn at +15% and fire at +30%.

sam-rl: Early telemetry: token throughput normal, a handful of 503s from a single edge - investigating.

deploy-bot: Observability check: traces show 4/10k requests with 503 from edge-3; autoscaling is disabled per freeze; marking for manual inspect.

maya-p: I ran sanity prompts for pricing calc flows — outputs look correct. No regressions in structured outputs.

ops-june: If edge-3 continues, rollback plan: immediate traffic-shift back to v2.6.9 + unpin matrix -> run `/deploy rollback target=v2.6.9 reason="edge-3 503s"` (sre-robin to execute).

sre-robin: On it. I also prepared a hot-unpin checklist in case we need to unpin quickly: 1) mark freeze-exception 2) notify billing 3) run traffic-shift 4) roll back canary record.

sam-rl: Canary at 15m now, p99 steady. Edge-3 503 count stabilized and dropped after connection pool reset.

deploy-bot: Canary metrics: error-rate 0.09% (within threshold), p95 +5ms, p99 +30ms. No action required.

ops-june: OK. Proceed to gradual ramp to 25% in 10 min, then 50% if clean. Remember: no schema or infra merges until release window closed.

maya-p: Copy. I'm posting final release note snippet to #release-notes channel now.

sam-rl: Starting ramp to 25% now. Command: `/deploy update-split release=v2.7.1 region=us-west split=25`

deploy-bot: Traffic split updated: v2.7.1 -> 25% in us-west.

sre-robin: Watching stacks. All green. A few minor increase in CPU on the large-ctx workers but under alarm threshold.

ops-june: Two housekeeping calls: 1) Keep the changelog immutable until post-window; 2) If you need an emergency hotfix during sterile window, add a freeze-exception tag and notify me immediately.

sam-rl: Noted. If anything goes sideways I'll run the rollback sequence and ping #war-room.

maya-p: Final check: billing sampling toggled to reduced retention per cost plan. Confirm?

ops-june: Confirmed. Reduced retention for debug traces enabled.

deploy-bot: Ramp to 50% scheduled in 10m.

sam-rl: 50% rolled at 20:25 UTC. No user-facing errors.

sre-robin: Threshold checks passed. No alerts firing.

ops-june: All clear to finish rollout to 100% in a controlled ramp. Reminder: keep an hour of post-launch monitoring with dedicated watchers.

maya-p: Post-launch evals queued (prompt set + synthetic traffic).

sam-rl: Rolling to 100% now. `/deploy update-split release=v2.7.1 split=100 region=us-west`

deploy-bot: Traffic split updated: v2.7.1 -> 100% in us-west. Full rollout complete.

sre-robin: Final check: no increase in error-rate, latency within SLO. Locking the freeze until post-monitor window ends.

ops-june: Thank you team. Closing sterile window in 60m unless we see regressions. If anyone needs to reopen, ping me with reason + mitigation. :thumbsup:

maya-p: Great run. Nicely coordinated.

sam-rl: Good work.

deploy-bot: Deploy session summary: release=v2.7.1, duration=22m, canary=5%->100%, smoke=PASS, rollback=standby.

ops-june: Logging final notes to the change log and marking release as deployed.

maya-p: Posting release notes link and customer-facing summary in #marketing after a short QA sweep.

ops-june: End of thread — sterile window active, monitoring until 21:25 UTC."
